title: Intent to Sole Source – ASSOCIATION OF NATIONAL ADVERTISERS, INC.
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE ARMY
detail_text: This is an Intent to Sole Source announcement. This is NOT a solicitation for proposals, proposal abstracts, or quotations. The purpose of this notice is to disseminate information regarding a forthcoming requirement. The Mission and Installation Contracting Command - Fort Knox (MICC-Fort Knox), located at 199 6th Avenue, Fort Knox, KY 40121, acting on behalf of the Army Enterprise Marketing Agency, intends to award a Firm-Fixed Price sole-source contract to: ASSOCIATION OF NATIONAL ADVERTISERS, INC. 155 E 44TH ST New York, New York 10017-4100 Unique Entity ID: PLLJNN6SWHB4 CAGE Code: 368R0 This sole-source award is being processed in accordance with 41 U.S.C. 1901, as implemented by the procedures in the Revolutionary FAR Overhaul (RFO) Part 12 . The specific authority for this action is RFO 12.106-1, "Soliciting From a Single Source," which states that a contract may be awarded without competition if the contracting officer determines the circumstances of the action deem only one source reasonably available to meet the Government's needs. A review of the System for Award Management (SAM) indicates that the ASSOCIATION OF NATIONAL ADVERTISERS, INC. has no active exclusions. This notice does not constitute a request for competitive offers, quotes, or capability statements. No solicitation document will be issued as a result of this notice. This announcement fulfills the public notification requirements established in RFO 5.101, "Methods of Disseminating Information."
